appRepositories.appDescription:
Search by frame: automatic video-area crop with manual adjustment

Phone screenshots with player controls or app UI around the video made
trace.moe return confident wrong matches (a test screenshot: wrong title at
88%; the same frame cropped: correct title at 98.8%). The picked image is
normalised, the video band is detected from row activity, shown in an
adjustable crop frame, and only the cropped frame is sent. Clean landscape
frames are searched immediately.
